items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Mr. Bartlow, Mr. Bartlow's brother out in St. John, sent me the correct age.

ctx.x: page? No. Mm-mm. You told him, say, come on now, babe, tell him your right age or something like that.

Mm-mm. He never would. He never would. And I laughed. I said, you know something? I said, I'm going to have more trouble. Sure enough, when he died, I did have trouble. Get somebody to prove his right age. Now, right now, it's the, his social security. I can't get it. I'm trying to get his right age. I done sent to, uh, they sent to the ain't in Washington no more. It's in Philadelphia. And that's where I had to send. And that gave his right age. They haven't sent it back to me yet, but Mr. Bartlow, Mr. Bartlow's…
They keep brackets, you know. Mm-hmm.
